description: Registry of the studio template sets in this repo. Tooling reads this file to discover what it can scaffold, which template set is current, and what each one costs in actions. A studio has MANY job roots and MANY template sets; neither is hardcoded anywhere.

job_roots.law: A job root is the parent directory that job directories live under. A studio may have several (current work, archive, fast scratch, a second facility, a client-segregated volume). The template variable 'project_root' names ONE of them at scaffold time. Job roots are site-local, so their real paths are NOT stored here and NOT stored in any project: they are declared once in the studio's own config and resolved per platform at use time. Nothing ever stores an absolute path.
job_roots.selection: Pass --var project_root=<resolved job root> at scaffold time. The scaffolded project records WHICH named job root it was created under (lib/cfg/project.json -> job_root), never the absolute path, so a tree stays relocatable and portable across macOS/Linux/Windows.

template_sets.description: Hybrid AI / live action / design / animation / VFX studio project. Eight top-level nouns (assets, context, lib, media, ref, shots, work + logs/.claude). The shot is a Maya-style project dir. Lazy by design: sequences, shots, assets and user sandboxes are scaffolded per entity, on first use, never up front. 2026.02 added the optional facet level (shots/{seq}[/{facet}]/{shot}); 2026.03 stopped scaffolding ref/ at the sequence and facet level; 2026.04 added c4d/ and lib/dcc/c4d/ to the shot; 2026.05 added pub/versions/ to the asset (the published, versioned product a shot references; work/ is where it is made). Source of truth: studio-pipeline/templates/studio_project (this is the published copy).

facet.run: once per facet (optional level: a sequence has facets or shots, never both)

vars.note: `dirtt placeholders` under-reports project.xml: it does not traverse into href'd seed files, so job_number/project_code/project_name/project_label/created_by (consumed by files/project.json and files/users.json) do not appear in its output. This list is the truth.

verified.dirtt: studio_scaffold planner (dirtt-compatible XML; dirtt CLI not run)

notes: dirtt substitutes {{vars}} inside href'd file CONTENT. A scaffold wrapper that pins this template set into the project's lib/dirtt/ must RAW-copy it, never route it through dirtt href, or the pinned copy loses its placeholders.
A literal '}}' anywhere in a template, XML comments included, is a dirtt TemplateError.
Re-running a template over an existing tree: directories skip, but <file> nodes refuse to overwrite. Wrappers need a skip-existing-files pass for idempotence.
chown applies only when run as root; chmod always. A non-root scaffold has correct modes and wrong owners.
The facet level is optional and invisible to shot.xml: pass shot_parent as shots/{seq} or shots/{seq}/{facet}; the shot's own action count does not change.
Re-running shot.xml over an existing shot with skip-existing-files adds new dirs (2026.04: c4d/, lib/dcc/c4d/) and leaves workspace.mel alone.
An asset is ref/ + work/ + pub/versions/ (2026.05). Re-running asset.xml over an existing asset with skip-existing-files adds pub/versions/.

template_sets.description: The filmcraft generative-development taxonomy: genai/{assets,context,renders,sequences,_work} plus a script/ writing tree. Development-stage work lives at sequence level; the reference production ran 14 sequences and never created a shot directory. Captured as a template so a project built this way can be migrated by map rather than by hand.

A VFX/post project structure as deployed at a studio circa 2015 (library/media/production/work/shots/flame). Kept as a working historical snapshot; updated only enough to run with dirtt 1.0 (relative href paths). This is the layout the 2015->2026.01 migration reads from.

migrations.note: Additive: no path moves. New dirs are created; a sequence-level ref/ that 2026.01 made is an orphan -- kept and reported, never deleted. Facets are opt-in per sequence and never inferred by a migration.
genai/ dissolves into the studio taxonomy rather than sitting beside it. Needs dirtt migrate --copy.

Maps to the 2026 draft layout (config/io/footage/editorial/apps/deliverables) that 2026.01 replaced. That draft template set is no longer in the repo; this map is kept as a record, not a route. Use 2015_to_2026.01.json.
